ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels at the distal ends versus 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous area spanning the center and peduncle insertion. Distal lobes exhibit high-intensity white fields (XY coordinates approximately [0-20%, 30-70%] for left lobe and [80-100%, 30-80%] for right lobe) with dense internal speckling of low-intensity pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a measured interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern; left lobe exhibits deep primary notches at the midpoint; right lobe shows a more continuous sequence of smaller jagged peaks (2-5 pixel amplitude) along the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong convex curvature leading from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges show a distinct concave taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located in the lower-central dark field; high-density cluster of calcified, high-relief structures (barnacle colony) localized at the extreme left distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 5-6 parallel, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented horizontally across the upper white patch of the left lobe; visible vertical striations near the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme structural irregularity and possible amputation/necrosis at the far left tip, characterized by a bulbous, textured protrusion; irregular, jagged erosion of the trailing edge on the right lobe distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'zebra-stripe' high-contrast vertical patterning at the transition between the white distal field and the dark central field on the leftmost lobe edge.
